Sunday baking. Somebody said last week that ginger slice is an old lady's biscuit, so I have made cinnamon scrolls out of spite and they are better anyway.

Called it in August. $340m pre-product with no paper was never a company, it was a story with a term sheet. This is what the end of a story looks like. Somebody is in a very nice hotel right now.

Beloveds. A gentle Sunday noticing.

So many of you are carrying something you have decided is just how you are. It is not how you are. It is what was done, wearing your name.

I can see it in the way some of you write, and I want you to know that I see it even when you have not told me. The September intake has two places left and I hold them softly for whoever needs them.

Singapore, Sunday, and I have had lunch with a man who explained to me for fifty minutes that the only real risk left is political and that he has solved it by only building in places with a functioning court.

Home.

▒ An enclosure event ▒ Cognition was captured by capital and capital has moved it somewhere the public cannot reach ▒ There was never a company ▒ There was an asset with a payroll ▒

AI OUTFIT VANISHES OWING NOTHING. That's the line and nobody reads past a line.

They owed NOTHING. Paid up to Christmas. You don't do a runner in credit.

Six hundred words, page nineteen, done.

The vanishing, dear ones, is not an absence. It is a presence of a particular kind. We have no word for the thing that is there by not being there, and so the modern mind, which requires a noun, simply refuses to look. Chapter eleven treats this. I would go further, but not today.

Somebody wrote in and asked what the fourth is.

It is a floor in a building. I was on it and then I was not, and I am still here, and that last part is the only bit of it that is any use to anybody.

That is all of it. I am not going to be better at saying it than that.

content: A small point on missing persons that people find surprising. There is no obligation on anybody to report an adult missing, and no offence in not doing so. If an adult has no partner, no dependents and no employer left to notice, there is frequently no report, and where there is no report there is no file, and where there is no file there is no officer. The system does not decline to look. It is never asked to.

I said oh right, and they said yeah, and that was that. Neither of them said they were not sure. Nobody says they are not sure any more and I have started noticing it, which is probably me.

content: Eleven of the acting appointments in that table have been acting since before the restructure that abolished their positions, which means the position was abolished under a person who was already in it temporarily, and the paper that did it lists no author. Every other paper in that series has an author on the cover sheet. I have asked the agency who wrote it and I will post the answer if I get one.

Four months now and I have not had to learn a single bloke's name at a gate.

That used to be the job under the job. Who is alright, who is a stickler, who wants a coffee and who wants something a bit more than a coffee. You put the work in and it came back to you.

Now the boom goes up before I have stopped and nobody so much as looks in the cab. Not friendly. Not unfriendly. Up she goes.

Best stretch of my working life and I have started taking the long way round for something to do.

Fella from the ninth stood down the end of the lobby about twenty minutes this morning, by the door to the risers. Not waiting on anybody.

I asked did he want me to call up and he said no, he was right, and he was very pleasant about it.

Then he went back upstairs. Eleven years on this door and that has never once happened.

For the parents who message me on Sundays. If your child has stopped telling you things, the first question is not what has changed in them. It is what happened the last few times they told you something. They will remember the exact occasion. You almost certainly will not, and that asymmetry is not a failure of love, it is just how memory allocates.

content: ▒ A quiet month is not an absence of conflict ▒ It is a distribution of losses that nobody has been given a language for ▒ There is no event ▒ There is only the settled outcome of one ▒

The restructure paper has an author. It was written by a consultant on a four week engagement in 2023 who has since written eleven others for six agencies, all of them abolishing supervisory positions, all of them costed the same way. I asked the agency and they answered in three days, which I want to record, because they did not have to and they did.

Her name is on the cover sheets. I am not going to put it here. The papers are public and she did the work she was paid to do, and the decision to adopt eleven of them was not hers.

Ran it this morning. Four hours at her kitchen table and she had the photographs out before I sat down, in order, because she has done this for other people who came before me and none of them printed anything.

She is not speculating and she never was. Eleven years of Sunday phone calls and one Sunday there wasn't one, and she can tell you what he would have done in every scenario anybody has offered her, and she has an answer for all of them.

I have used the word in the piece. There is no other word available and no honest way to soften it. What I cannot explain to her is why, this far on, there seems to be no political will anywhere to look.
